name: macro-deck-ui
description: Macro Deck UI - framework-free runtime, Angular clients and the Tauri bootstrapper

scripts.build: npm run build -w @macro-deck/runtime && npm run build:prod -w macro-deck-ui-angular
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build -w @macro-deck/runtime && npm run build:desktop -w macro-deck-ui-angular -- --configuration=production
scripts.build:web-client: npm run build -w @macro-deck/runtime && npm run build -w @macro-deck/web-client
